messages.subject: Booking now open: 'Expert evidence under CPR Part 35' lunchtime seminar
messages.plaintextBody:
Booking is now open for our lunchtime CPD seminar 'Expert evidence under CPR Part 35: getting the best from your expert', Thursday 27 March, 12:30-13:30, Training Room 2 (sandwiches provided). 1 hour CPD. Reserve your place via the L&D portal.
